Local JavaScript glue modification: record each Emscripten exit status in
Module.__exitStatus so the practical runtime can preserve command failures.
Modified files: cat.js, comm.js, cut.js, head.js, join.js, paste.js, seq.js, sort.js, tail.js, tee.js, tr.js, uniq.js, wc.js
The WebAssembly binaries and associated data assets are unmodified.
